purpose: Compare Luna, DeepSeek, and Qwen on identical fresh Optimise sites after the original Phase 4 analysis was frozen.

analysis.tool_estimands: Within each model, inference minus bare final simple regret on Optimise
analysis.model_estimands: Pairwise model differences within tool mode on identical Optimise sites
analysis.multiplicity: Two prespecified BH families: three within-model inference-minus-bare contrasts; six pairwise model contrasts split by bare and inference mode
analysis.missing_episode_rule: retry transport/rate failures with the same identity; retain format failures, infeasible designs, and model early stopping; report missing cells without imputation
analysis.stopping_rule: no efficacy stopping; pauses may depend only on spend, rate limits, or service availability

cost_plan_usd.basis: Existing Phase 4 token usage and OpenRouter list prices checked 2026-09-19

prompt_hash_policy: record protocol-template SHA256 and realized-prompt SHA256 per episode
api_metadata_policy: record requested and actual model, provider, timestamp, generation seed, usage, cost, retry attempt, and finish reason
